verses.text: 'Now you son of man, get yourself a brick, place it before you and inscribe a city on it, Jerusalem.
verses.textZh: 人子啊，你要拿一塊磚，擺在你面前，將一座耶路撒冷城畫在其上，

verses.text: 'Then lay siege against it, build a siege wall, raise up a ramp, pitch camps and place battering rams against it all around.
verses.textZh: 又圍困這城，造臺築壘，安營攻擊，在四圍安設撞錘攻城，

verses.text: 'Then get yourself an iron plate and set it up as an iron wall between you and the city, and set your face toward it so that it is under siege, and besiege it. This is a sign to the house of Israel.
verses.textZh: 又要拿個鐵鏊，放在你和城的中間，作為鐵牆。你要對面攻擊這城，使城被困；這樣，好作以色列家的預兆。

verses.text: 'As for you, lie down on your left side and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it; you shall bear their iniquity for the number of days that you lie on it.
verses.textZh: 你要向左側臥，承當以色列家的罪孽；要按你向左側臥的日數，擔當他們的罪孽。

verses.text: 'For I have assigned you a number of days corresponding to the years of their iniquity, three hundred and ninety days; thus you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
verses.textZh: 因為我已將他們作孽的年數定為你向左側臥的日數，就是三百九十日，你要這樣擔當以色列家的罪孽。

verses.text: 'When you have completed these, you shall lie down a second time, [but] on your right side and bear the iniquity of the house of Judah; I have assigned it to you for forty days, a day for each year.
verses.textZh: 再者，你滿了這些日子，還要向右側臥，擔當猶大家的罪孽。我給你定規側臥四十日，一日頂一年。

verses.text: 'Then you shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem with your arm bared and prophesy against it.
verses.textZh: 你要露出膀臂，面向被困的耶路撒冷，說預言攻擊這城。

verses.text: 'Now behold, I will put ropes on you so that you cannot turn from one side to the other until you have completed the days of your siege.
verses.textZh: 我用繩索捆綁你，使你不能輾轉，直等你滿了困城的日子。

verses.text: 'But as for you, take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet and spelt, put them in one vessel and make them into bread for yourself; you shall eat it according to the number of the days that you lie on your side, three hundred and ninety days.
verses.textZh: 你要取小麥、大麥、豆子、紅豆、小米、粗麥，裝在一個器皿中，用以為自己做餅；要按你側臥的三百九十日吃這餅。

verses.text: 'Your food which you eat [shall be] twenty shekels a day by weight; you shall eat it from time to time.
verses.textZh: 你所吃的要按分兩吃，每日二十舍客勒，按時而吃。

verses.text: 'The water you drink shall be the sixth part of a hin by measure; you shall drink it from time to time.
verses.textZh: 你喝水也要按制子，每日喝一欣六分之一，按時而喝。

verses.text: 'You shall eat it as a barley cake, having baked [it] in their sight over human dung.'
verses.textZh: 你吃這餅像吃大麥餅一樣，要用人糞在眾人眼前燒烤。

verses.text: Then the LORD said, 'Thus will the sons of Israel eat their bread unclean among the nations where I will banish them.'
verses.textZh: 耶和華說：以色列人在我所趕他們到的各國中，也必這樣吃不潔淨的食物。

verses.text: But I said, 'Ah, Lord GOD! Behold, I have never been defiled; for from my youth until now I have never eaten what died of itself or was torn by beasts, nor has any unclean meat ever entered my mouth.'
verses.textZh: 我說：哎！主耶和華啊，我素來未曾被玷污，從幼年到如今沒有吃過自死的，或被野獸撕裂的，那可憎的肉也未曾入我的口。

verses.text: Then He said to me, 'See, I will give you cow's dung in place of human dung over which you will prepare your bread.'
verses.textZh: 於是他對我說：看哪，我給你牛糞代替人糞，你要將你的餅烤在其上。

verses.text: Moreover, He said to me, 'Son of man, behold, I am going to break the staff of bread in Jerusalem, and they will eat bread by weight and with anxiety, and drink water by measure and in horror,
verses.textZh: 他又對我說：人子啊，我必在耶路撒冷折斷他們的杖，就是斷絕他們的糧。他們吃餅要按分兩，憂慮而吃；喝水也要按制子，驚惶而喝；

verses.text: because bread and water will be scarce; and they will be appalled with one another and waste away in their iniquity.
verses.textZh: 使他們缺糧缺水，彼此驚惶，因自己的罪孽消滅。
